protected_assets.description: Global managed Capability catalog and active immutable Skill packages
Durable Session workspace binding and canonical execution root
User files in selected and automatically created directories
Existing Tool authorization, confirmation, health, platform policy boundary, and persisted permission-mode intent

trusted_assumptions.description: The current developer account, OS kernel, gate program, and absolute-path system programs are trusted
A directory explicitly confirmed through the native picker represents the user's workspace intent

in_scope_failures.description: A global Skill is incorrectly copied or bound to one Project or Session
A failed install exposes a partial package or replaces the last valid global catalog
Default workspace creation collides, drifts, or leaves a half-bound Session
Existing or newly created Sessions receive different Skill or Tool discoverable catalogs
Universal Tool discoverability bypasses execution authorization or availability policy
UI reports install success before a verifiable publish receipt and runtime visibility proof
Production traffic is accidentally wired through a legacy loader or dormant RunKernel seam
Default automatic permission mode bypasses Skill source validation or fails to preserve a user's explicit override
A failed Skill install leaves the durable SDK Run waiting without an explicit recovery or cancellation path while the UI falsely reports installation progress

in_scope_adversaries.description: Malformed or malicious Skill Git content using traversal, symlinks, or an invalid manifest

out_of_scope_conditions.description: The host OS, developer account, or deterministic gate is compromised
A new cryptographic Skill supply-chain signing infrastructure

maximum_acceptable_impact: A failure may reject only the current install operation or Session creation; it must not alter the prior valid global catalog, other Session bindings, or existing user files.
